spans.s:
(ई) पृची r. 2nd cl. (पृक्ते) r. 7th cl. (पृणक्ति)
To touch, to be or bring in contact.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (पर्चति पर्चयति)
1 To hinder or restrain.
2 To touch.

m. (-कः)
An inquirer, an investigator, an inquisitive person.
E.
प्रच्छ to ask, वुन् aff., र changed to ऋ.

n. (-णं)
Asking, inquiring.
E.
पृच्छ to ask, ल्युट् aff., र changed to ऋ.

f. (-च्छा)
Asking, questioning, a question or inquiry.
E.
प्रच्छ to inquire, aff. अङ् and टाप्, the semivowel changed to the corresponding vowel.
